headline: ServiceNow has announced Flow, an AI chat-based IT help desk aimed at mid-sized companies that already work in Slack or Microsoft Teams.
score_reason: Pool score 6 lowered by 1: announced Thursday 1 Oct 2026, before today's window, and the claims come from ServiceNow's own executives.
importance_line: Mid-sized firms that run IT requests through chat get a ready-made AI help desk and ServiceNow's partner companies get a new product to sell, but pricing for new customers is not settled and the quick-setup claims come from ServiceNow executives.
summary: CRN reports that ServiceNow, which mainly sells to very large businesses, announced on 1 Oct 2026 an AI help desk called Flow that employees can use in chat tools such as Slack and Teams to get IT problems solved. It is due to reach existing customers in North America from 6 Oct 2026 and everyone worldwide later this year, priced by how much the AI is used, and ServiceNow executive Jeff Hausman says it can be running within minutes or hours.
notes: Event dated 1 Oct 2026 from CRN's 'Thursday'; CRN published it 2 Oct 2026. Score lowered 1 for that reason; editor may restore it if the 1 Oct announcement counts as within the window.
